summary: Targeted re-test of Admin flows #3 (customer loyalty management) and #5 (loyalty perks editor per tier) plus a quick mobile nav check on /. All three flows PASS end-to-end via the public URL. Admin login OK; Clients tab shows points/tier/parrainage columns; the loyalty management modal correctly applies +250 / -100 deltas, updates the row's points cell, applies manual Gold override (label 'manuel' shown), and recomputes tier back to BRONZE when set to Automatique. Loyalty perks editor allows add/edit/delete of perks under tier 0 (BRONZE), save triggers a success toast, and the new perk 'Test avantage BRONZE' appears on the public /fidelite page under tier-card-BRONZE. Mobile menu (viewport 375x812) opens and exposes mobile-nav-fidelite (/fidelite) and mobile-nav-carte-cadeau (/carte-cadeau) with correct hrefs.

issues: Modal does not close on ESC key; only the X icon (no data-testid) closes it. Minor UX and testability concern - consider adding data-testid='customer-loyalty-modal-close' and ESC handler.

action_items: (Optional/minor) Add data-testid on the modal close button and enable ESC-to-close for the customer loyalty modal to improve UX and testability.
critical_code_review_comments: Admin.jsx is very large (>1200 lines) - consider splitting each Panel (CustomersPanel, LoyaltyAdminPanel, etc.) into its own file for maintainability.
Modal close is only via an icon-only button without data-testid - add one and support ESC/backdrop click to close.
